stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[5].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

syntax_lists_ranges_steps.statement: Fields accept *, comma lists, ranges a-b, and steps */n, a-b/n, a/n, expanding to the correct value sets.

names_case_insensitive.statement: Month and day names parse case-insensitively alone, in lists and in ranges; 0 and 7 are both Sunday.

validate_explains.statement: validate on a valid expression prints one explanation line per field and exits 0.

validate_errors.statement: Out-of-range values, bad tokens, reversed ranges, zero steps and wrong field counts make validate exit 2 naming the field and reason.

next_runs.statement: next -n N prints N ascending run times strictly after the start, each matching the expression; N defaults to 5.
must_include: next prints the next N run times

impossible_dates.statement: 0 0 30 2 * and 0 0 31 4 * are reported as never matching; next prints no times, exits 2 and terminates.

dom_dow_leap.statement: With both day fields restricted a date matches if either matches; 0 0 29 2 * runs only in leap years.
